title: How do I create a good rpg world with AI?
author: kavakravata
selftext:
Hey!

I have systems in place to generate a world according to shape with biomes, though a bit inconsistent with rivers etc.

I have a huge problem with how I can populate this world with trees, rocks, clutter, and POI’s and cities now.

Do I use Godot editor for that, or is there a good way to do this with claude? In what format does Claude want such information?

Ive tried all kinds of prompts and images but it never turns out good.

Taking all ideas, thanks a bunch

comments.author: astr0nic
comments.body: Many small prompts are organized into a methodical series of human review gates. They feed into larger prompts, while independent prompts check the work and higher-level overseer prompts review the entire process. The result is mostly human-gated but bot-made.

replies.author: kavakravata
replies.body: I see! Do you have any examples to show? Need some help with the prompting

replies.author: astr0nic
replies.body: No this is just general advise, get the bot to help you - see where I'm going there 😉

comments.author: Nervous_Teach_5596
comments.body: The name of you want is procedural generation I think

replies.author: kavakravata
replies.body: I have it for world continents and biomes, but not for the details on the map, houses etc, really hard to get right

replies.author: Nervous_Teach_5596
replies.body: Maybe you can do in a way that you verify each iteration is ok, to your logic, on pieces of world that that logic should work, it's yet procedural, but not fully random

comments.author: last1031
comments.body: think there is a integration for claude and godot, there was a git though I havent tried it

comments.author: Sufficient_Crew_5321
comments.body: AI can help with world concepts, lore, quests, and biome ideas, but I'd still recommend manually designing the core gameplay areas. Use AI for brainstorming and content generation, then refine everything inside your game engine to keep the world consistent and fun to explore.

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
you need to define rules e.g. trees should not be too close to rivers or trees should occasionally spawn close to each other to form forests

Claude can do it but you need to specify exactly how the world works. 

image generation is a whole another situation.
